name: nebulashell
description: Docker-backed browser Linux terminal emulator with React, Socket.IO, node-pty, and Express.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
